text:
```yaml
name: PR Title Lint

on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  lint-pr-title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --only=dev @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional husky

      - name: Configure commitlint
        run: echo "module.exports = { extends: ['@commitlint/config-conventional'] };" > commitlint.config.js

      - name: Initialize Husky
        run: npx husky-init && npm install

      - name: Add commit-msg hook
        run: npx husky add .husky/commit-msg "npx --no-install commitlint --edit $1"

      - name: Validate PR title
        run: |
          git fetch origin pull/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/head:pr-branch
          git checkout pr-branch
          git log -1 --pretty=%B | npx commitlint --from -
```
